title: Targeted practical surface-boundary repair
central_question: Can frozen S4 be given a minimal mass-conservative surface-boundary process that admits authentic rainfall without changing its vertical representation or hydraulic closure?
trigger: P6B realistic forcing localized fixed-flux top-boundary semantics as the dominant practical defect.

allowed: one explicit surface store/ponding accounting variable outside the four hydraulic states
infiltration limited by a physically defined surface-to-first-layer hydraulic capacity
excess rainfall retained as ponding and/or explicit runoff according to one preregistered bounded rule
mass ledger including surface storage and runoff

candidate_variants.definition: single surface store with rainfall mass input; infiltration flux bounded by first-layer hydraulic intake; excess remains in surface store up to a fixed zero-calibration capacity, then explicit runoff

qualification_order: derive SB1 equations and mass signs from existing SWAP top-boundary semantics where possible
only if numerically complete, compare storage/profile timing against Richards with semantically matching rainfall/surface handling
